item.description:

Institution: Univ. VERONA, Verona
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-07 Biochimica

The researcher will carry out experimental activities within the ALGAVES project, aimed at developing extracellular vesicles (EVs) derived from engineered microalgae as delivery systems for ketocarotenoids and tocopherol. Activities will include EV isolation and purification and their characterization by NTA, TEM, DLS and Western blot. The researcher will contribute to bioactive compound quantification by HPLC and to EV uptake studies in HaCaT keratinocytes by confocal microscopy. Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects will be assessed through ROS and redox status. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Development of cDC1-selective gene-targeting strategies for cancer immunotherapy. (Univ. PERUGIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-29 23:59
Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-11 Farmacologia

The project aims to develop gene-targeting and genome-editing strategies for the selective modulation of conventional type 1 dendritic cells (cDC1) in cancer immunotherapy. Activities will include the design of systems targeting regulatory regions, vector engineering, and optimization of selective AhR targeting in cDC1. Strategies will be characterized by molecular, flow-cytometric and gene-expression analyses to assess efficiency, selectivity, stability and potential off-target effects, and validated in primary dendritic cells and preclinical models to determine their impact on antitumor immune responses.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Development of strategies for the protection of marine species and habitats from the potential impacts arising from the spread of the Union-concern alga Rugulopteryx okamurae (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-01 Botanica

Rugulopteryx okamurae is a brown algae belonging to the family Dictyotaceae, native to the Pacific Northwest. In Europe, it was first reported in 2002 in France, in the Thau lagoon, where it is believed to have been introduced accidentally, probably through the import of Pacific oysters. In view of the significant impact on marine-coastal ecosystems, R. okamurae has been included among the species of Union concern under Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/1203 (2 July 2022). Species whose adverse effects on the environment and biodiversity are such as to require coordinated action by Member States are defined as being of Union concern.

item.title: Incarico di ricerca: MITEPA (Integrated Territorial Model for Prenatal Exposure to Alcohol) - Protection of human capital and prevention of disorders due to prenatal exposure to alcohol: an integrated territorial model (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-11 Farmacologia

Fetal Alcohol Spectrum Disorders (FASD) are a condition of significant interest for public health, as they derive from prenatal exposure to alcohol and are associated with adverse physical, cognitive, behavioral and social outcomes. Recent Italian guidelines underline that FASD is an irreversible condition and that total abstention from alcohol consumption during pregnancy is the only effective preventive measure, in the absence of decisive therapeutic protocols.
